description.text:
One of the two expansions that opened the Pokémon Card Game BW series on 17 December 2010, released together with White Collection. Every Pokémon in the two packs' numbered lists is new in the Nintendo DS games Pokémon Black and White, and the two lists share no cards, so together they gather the new Pokémon of the Unova region; Black Collection holds Reshiram and Emboar. The cards are numbered to 53, followed by Super Rare Tornadus and Reshiram and an Ultra Rare Pikachu, which White Collection also holds. In English most of the cards came out in Black & White in April 2011, and Tornadus in Emerging Powers in August 2011.

BW changed the cards and the packs. Rarity is printed as a letter, C, U or R, instead of a symbol, and hidden Super Rare and Ultra Rare cards appear past the end of the numbering. Poké-Powers and Poké-Bodies gave way to Abilities, and cards in ready-made decks stopped carrying the 1st Edition mark. Packs shrank to five cards, with no guaranteed holo and no basic Energy.
